items.title: Access OpenAI gpt-oss Models at OCI Generative AI
items.content: OCI Generative AI currently supports pre-trained models of OpenAI gpt-oss, designed for both reasoning and agent tasks. `openai.gpt-oss-120b` is recommended for workloads complex and high demand resources and `openai.gpt-oss-20b` for local use that require lower latency. The models are available under demand and as endpoints that are deployed in dedicated AI clusters. The details of the functions are contained in Generative AI's documentation.

cover.alt: Access OpenAI gpt-oss Models at OCI Generative AI

items.title: Add Storage Files to Generative AI Applications
items.content:
The applications housed at OCI Generative AI support persistent storage files. They allow to save model artifacts, intermediate results, checkpoints and state from the application on a configured container path and to preserve them between restarts and redeployments.

When creating a housed application, they can be added up to 50 GB from storage files from Console or using `API`. That version supports a single application replica with storage files. sets at 1 both minimum and maximum number of replicas.

For more details, see Persistent File Storage for Hosted Applications. To start with, check Creating an Application.
